subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should OpenClaw accept `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` as the supported hook-level model override for LLM session-memory slug generation?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and reuses the embedded runner resolver, but it turns a previously open-ended hook config key into user-visible provider/model routing behavior.

options.title: Accept hook model contract
options.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as supported config and land this PR after normal branch refresh and checks.

options.title: Require stronger upgrade wording
options.body: Ask for public docs or release-note wording that calls out the newly consumed key before merge.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want slug routing solved by a different product-level model setting instead.

recommendation.title: Accept hook model contract
recommendation.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as supported config and land this PR after normal branch refresh and checks.

likelyOwner.reason: His hooks-system and recent session-memory history make him the best available owner for the config-contract choice.
